description: VCI Global Limited provides comprehensive consulting expertise across Malaysia, China, Singapore, and the United States. The firm's strategic business advisory services span public listing solutions, corporate finance, legal guidance, investor relations, and boardroom-level strategies. Complementing this, it provides technology consultancy, delivering advanced software solutions in artificial intelligence, analytics, and robotics, alongside diverse blockchain applications. VCI Global's client portfolio is extensive, serving small and medium-sized enterprises, government-linked entities, and publicly traded conglomerates across numerous sectors. Established in 2013, its operational base is located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
